title: Bleach Thousand-Year Blood War The Calamity streams on Hulu this month
text:
VIZ Media confirmed that the final arc of the popular anime, Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War - The Calamity, will premiere on Hulu on July 25 and also on Disney+ internationally. The installment continues the adaptation of Tite Kubo's manga as the saga nears its end, featuring Soul Reapers, Quincies, and the destructive confrontation over the Soul King. Producing credits include Pierrot Films, director Tomohisa Taguchi, composer Shiro Sagisu, and creative oversight by Kubo.
BLEACH : Thousand-Year Blood War – The Calamity to stream on Hulu this month VIZ Media confirmed that BLEACH : Thousand-Year Blood War – The Calamity arrives on July 25 at 7:30 a.m. PDT.
The anime will stream exclusively on Hulu in the U.S. and on Disney+ in select international territories, according to a press release. This installment continues the adaptation of Tite Kubo’s iconic manga as the saga nears its end. Hidden truths surrounding the Soul Reapers emerge while Ichigo Kurosaki faces a battle with consequences for every world. Pierrot Films handles production with Tomohisa Taguchi directing and sharing series composition duties with Masaki Hiramatsu.
Composer Shiro Sagisu returns to score the series, and Kubo maintains direct creative oversight of the final arc.
“BLEACH helped define modern anime for an entire generation of fans and creators, and its impact continues to be felt around the world today,” said Brian Ige, General Manager at VIZ Media. “BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War – The Calamity marks a pivotal moment in the final arc of this extraordinary story, bringing audiences closer than ever to its long-awaited conclusion.
We’re excited for fans everywhere to experience what is shaping up to be one of the most unforgettable chapters in anime history. ” The manga first appeared in Weekly Shonen Jump before expanding into a global property. The franchise now spans television, film, video games, consumer products, and live events. Its revival through BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War has drawn massive renewed attention worldwide.
The series regularly ranks among the top anime titles in viewership and online discussion. According to the official synopsis, the war between Soul Reapers and Quincies reaches a critical turning point. Yhwach shatters Squad Zero’s defenses and enters the Royal Palace. Ichigo is then tricked into cutting down the Soul King, sending shockwaves of destruction across all three realms.
